lines.text: Here are your sandwiches in a bag. Do you need anything else to take away?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Sorry, I think there is a mix-up. We want to eat here, please.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: Oh, you said for here. I will put the sandwiches on plates for you.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Thank you. One more thing: we asked for one chicken sandwich and one cheese sandwich.
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: I have two chicken sandwiches on the order. Let me change the second one to cheese.
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Great. Could you tell me what the order says now?
lines.speaker: Eli

lines.text: One chicken, one cheese, both for here. Is that right?
lines.speaker: Nora

lines.text: Yes, that is right. Thank you for fixing it.
lines.speaker: Eli
